description: Returns the exact EIP-712 typed data (eth_signTypedData_v4) for a listing (kind listing, the seller's wallet) or an offer (kind offer, the bidder's wallet) on one domain: price, asset, the wallet's current cancel counter, a fresh nonce and salt, and an expiry. For when a person wants to list a name or make an offer and will sign it in their own wallet. It stores nothing, signs nothing and publishes nothing: only the wallet's owner can sign, and only a person signed in on Scopeweb can publish or accept. amount is an integer in the smallest unit: cents for asset_kind usd_cents, wei or token units for native or erc20.

amount.description: Integer in the smallest unit of the asset

asset_chain_id.description: Chain the payment is made on (native or erc20)

chain_id.description: Chain id the wallet signs on: 1, 8453, 10, 42161 or 137

token.description: ERC-20 contract address, for asset_kind erc20

wallet.description: The EVM address that will sign (0x...)

name: prepare_typed_data
